conditional_contents_projection.claim: For the successful S length2 path, changing one valid nonzero response address to another can leave the two copied bytes and downstream packet bytes equal, under ALL listed conditions. This is a conditional packet-content observation, not equality of all registers, memory, faults, timing, addresses, status or ABI.
conditions: Allocation slot70 must not observe or retain ambient source pointerA2/other address-derived residue, inspect caller/callee frame addresses, or introduce address-dependent effects. This has NOT been established.

Allocation must normally return a valid destination and preserve the specific liveSP/S1/S0/S2/S3/frame roles required by App, or supply explicitly equivalent values. No ordinary ABI is assumed for unknown installed ROM.
The fresh copy slot must actually select one of the exact reviewed candidate bodies, or a separately proved provider with the same relevant footprint and outputs. Installed identity is NOT proved.

Both source locations hold the same two bytes when each byte is freshly read; destinations and all App frames, records, code, MMIO and source regions do not introduce alias-dependent differences. Memory/slot accesses and FENCE.I complete normally with no intervening writes/asynchronous events affecting the comparison.

TX gate and terminal providers, subsequent release and caller continuations must satisfy their separate live-state/ambient-input contracts and not observe the differing private pointer/address history. Existing TX source evidence alone does not prove installed ROM behavior.
conditional_contents_projection.does_not_establish: Global address nonescape; arbitrary alias equivalence; hidden ROM footprint; pointwise register/fault/IRQ equality; physical stackABI; original placement; BOOT/CRC/signature/OTA/hardware readiness.
